newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield falls to 2.530 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd 10-yr JGB yield falls to 2.530 pct.

text.p: The yield of the key 182nd 10-year cash Japanese government bond (JGB) fell 10 basis points to 2.530 percent in late morning Tokyo, traders said.
The yield fell sharply on the back of investor cash bond buying at the long end of the JGB yield curve on Friday morning, traders said.

There was a growing view in the market after Thursday's weaker-than-expected industrial output data that Japan is unlikely to raise its discount rate until the latter half of this year, encouraging banks and other investors to take profits from the yield spread between the short- and long-term maturities, they said.
